title: Users
subtitle_admin: Panel accounts: admins, resellers and customers.

empty.title_reseller: You have no customer accounts yet
empty.desc: Get started by creating a new account.

table.no_password_title: No password set — this account cannot log in

modal_new.username_hint: 3-32 characters, starts with a lowercase letter; may contain letters, digits, _ and -.
modal_new.password_hint: At least 8 characters. The password is only shown now — pass it on to the user.
modal_new.role_hint_reseller: Resellers can only create customer accounts.

modal_password.title: Set Password
modal_password.user_hint: This is the customer's panel account password. The customer can only log in to the panel with this username and password; they cannot log in without a password set.

modal_limits.title: Reseller Limits
modal_limits.zero_hint: If both are 0, the limit record is removed entirely.
modal_limits.package_filled_hint: The 4 fields below were filled from the "{{name}}" package; select "Enter manually" to change them.
modal_limits.package_manual_hint: If you don't select a package, you enter the limits manually.
modal_limits.overselling_hint: If disabled, the reseller cannot exceed their disk/traffic quota in the total disk/traffic they commit to customers (equivalent to WHM's "Overselling" setting).
modal_limits.plans_label: Service plans that can be assigned to customers
modal_limits.plans_hint: If none are checked there is no restriction — the reseller can use all service plans.
modal_limits.no_limit_defined: No limit defined for this reseller — currently unlimited.
modal_limits.footer_hint: Going below the limit does not delete existing accounts or take sites down; it only blocks adding new customers/domains. Disk and traffic are based on the last measurement.

confirm_delete.title: Delete account
confirm_delete.message_reseller_extra: Accounts under this reseller will not be deleted, they will be transferred to the admin.
